entries_food.name: entries_food
entries_food.value: ("entries"."kind" = 'food') = ("entries"."food_id" IS NOT NULL AND "entries"."grams" IS NOT NULL)

entries_food_fields.name: entries_food_fields
entries_food_fields.value: "entries"."kind" = 'food' OR ("entries"."food_id" IS NULL AND "entries"."grams" IS NULL AND "entries"."portion_count" IS NULL)

entries_meal.name: entries_meal
entries_meal.value: ("entries"."kind" = 'saved_meal') = ("entries"."saved_meal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "entries"."meal_count" IS NOT NULL)

entries_meal_fields.name: entries_meal_fields
entries_meal_fields.value: "entries"."kind" = 'saved_meal' OR ("entries"."saved_meal_id" IS NULL AND "entries"."meal_count" IS NULL)

entries_portion.name: entries_portion
entries_portion.value: ("entries"."portion_count" IS NULL) = ("entries"."portion_unit" IS NULL AND "entries"."portion_name" IS NULL) AND ("entries"."portion_unit" IS NULL OR "entries"."portion_name" IS NULL) AND ("entries"."portion_id" IS NULL OR "entries"."portion_count" IS NOT NULL)

entries_amounts.name: entries_amounts
entries_amounts.value: ("entries"."grams" IS NULL OR "entries"."grams" > 0) AND ("entries"."meal_count" IS NULL OR "entries"."meal_count" > 0) AND ("entries"."portion_count" IS NULL OR "entries"."portion_count" > 0)

foods_values_in_range.name: foods_values_in_range
foods_values_in_range.value: "foods"."energy_kcal" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000 AND "foods"."protein_g" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "foods"."carbs_g" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "foods"."fat_g" BETWEEN 0 AND 100

recipe_ingredients_kind.name: recipe_ingredients_kind
recipe_ingredients_kind.value: ("recipe_ingredients"."food_id" IS NULL) = ("recipe_ingredients"."grams" IS NULL) AND ("recipe_ingredients"."food_id" IS NULL) = ("recipe_ingredients"."name" IS NOT NULL)

recipe_ingredients_portion.name: recipe_ingredients_portion
recipe_ingredients_portion.value: ("recipe_ingredients"."portion_count" IS NULL) = ("recipe_ingredients"."portion_unit" IS NULL AND "recipe_ingredients"."portion_name" IS NULL) AND ("recipe_ingredients"."portion_unit" IS NULL OR "recipe_ingredients"."portion_name" IS NULL) AND ("recipe_ingredients"."portion_id" IS NULL OR "recipe_ingredients"."portion_count" IS NOT NULL)

recipe_ingredients_portion_counted.name: recipe_ingredients_portion_counted
recipe_ingredients_portion_counted.value: "recipe_ingredients"."portion_count" IS NULL OR "recipe_ingredients"."food_id" IS NOT NULL

recipe_ingredients_name_len.name: recipe_ingredients_name_len
recipe_ingredients_name_len.value: "recipe_ingredients"."name" IS NULL OR char_length("recipe_ingredients"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 80

recipe_ingredients_note_len.name: recipe_ingredients_note_len
recipe_ingredients_note_len.value: "recipe_ingredients"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("recipe_ingredients"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 80

recipe_ingredients_written.name: recipe_ingredients_written
recipe_ingredients_written.value: ("recipe_ingredients"."written_amount" IS NULL) = ("recipe_ingredients"."written_unit" IS NULL) AND ("recipe_ingredients"."written_amount" IS NULL OR "recipe_ingredients"."written_amount" > 0)

saved_meals_values_in_range.name: saved_meals_values_in_range
saved_meals_values_in_range.value: "saved_meals"."energy_kcal" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "saved_meals"."protein_g" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000 AND "saved_meals"."carbs_g" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000 AND "saved_meals"."fat_g" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000

users_has_sign_in_method.name: users_has_sign_in_method
users_has_sign_in_method.value: "users"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."google_id" IS NOT NULL
